TIMEATHON
SWIM  ·  BIKE  ·  RUN

Timeathon: live race timing from your phone

Run a triathlon, swim meet or bike ride with nothing but phones. Start everyone at once or one at a time, log splits with a tap, and let parents count laps from the pool deck.

For spectators

Follow every athlete live: the race clock, each leg's time, and live age-group standings, right on your phone.

For race directors

Instant results, finisher certificates with your logo and signature, results emails for families, race photo albums, GPS course maps, Garmin watch support and Keiser spin bike distance tracking.

Youth triathlons, kids' tris, indoor and reverse triathlons, summer swim leagues and group rides.
